body: This PR updates the diagnostics written in pressure coordinates to use `ClimaCore.Remapping.LogLinearInPressure()`. This interpolates linearly in the logarithm of pressure instead of linearly in pressure.
title: Interpolate diagnostics in log pressure

body:
## Summary

Adds two mixed-phase Arctic stratocumulus single-column model (SCM) benchmarks — **ISDAC** (Ovchinnikov et al., 2014) and **M-PACE** Case B (Klein et al., 2009) — for `PrognosticEDMFX` with 1-moment microphysics, along with Buildkite CI jobs and literature-based intercomparison plots.

## Changes

- **M-PACE case setup (`Setups.MPACE`, `MPACEForcing`):**
  - Hydrostatically integrated initial $\theta_{li}(p)$ and $q_t(p)$ profiles from Klein et al. (2009), extended above an Arctic tropopause (`300` hPa isothermal stratosphere, `q_top = 3e-6` kg/kg floor) to support full-column RRTMGP on the 79-level AMIP stretched grid (`z_max: 60e3`).
  - Prescribed surface fluxes (`shf = 136.5` W m⁻², `lhf = 107.7` W m⁻², `z0 = 1e-4` m, `T_sfc = 274.01` K), large-scale subsidence and cold-air advective cooling/drying tapered smoothly to zero between `550` and `450` hPa, `MPACEForcing` horizontal wind nudging toward `(-13, -3)` m/s (`τ = 3600` s), and time-varying insolation starting `17Z 9 October 2004`.
- **ISDAC SCM updates (`Setups.ISDAC`, `RadiationISDAC`):**
  - Sets `Setups.ISDAC` surface sensible and latent heat fluxes to zero (`shf = 0`, `lhf = 0`) per Ovchinnikov et al. (2014), Appendix A2.
  - Applies `RadiationISDAC` parameterized longwave cooling consistently to `PrognosticEDMFX` updraft MSE.
- **Configs, CI, docs, & post-processing:**
  - Adds `prognostic_edmfx_isdac_column.yml` (38-level stretched grid to `2.5` km matching AMIP levels below `2.5` km) and `prognostic_edmfx_mpace_column.yml` (79-level AMIP stretched grid to `60` km with `rad: allskywithclear`), wired into `.buildkite/full_pipeline.yml` and `post_processing/ci_plots.jl`.
  - Adds literature reference data (`post_processing/scm_literature_references.jl`) and updates `edmf_scm_intercomparison.jl` / `run_all_scm_intercomparisons.jl` to plot ISDAC (6–8 h average vs. Ovchinnikov et al. 2014 LES) and M-PACE (4–12 h average vs. Klein et al. 2009 CRM ensemble).
  - Documents `Setups.MPACE` and `MPACEForcing` and adds unit tests in `test/config/model_from_config.jl`.

## Behavioral Changes

- **`Setups.ISDAC` surface fluxes:** Prescribes `shf = 0` and `lhf = 0` (with `z0 = 4e-4` m) per Ovchinnikov et al. (2014), Appendix A2: *"both sensible and latent surface heat fluxes are set to zero in these simulations"*. Previously, `MoninObukhov(; z0 = 4e-4)` computed interactive surface fluxes from `T_sfc = 267` K, so this alters existing ISDAC configurations such as `les_isdac_box.yml`.
title: Add M-PACE and ISDAC to SCM comparison plots
